data.name: Maysun
data.gender_notes: Maysun is used as a unisex name in Islamic naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: Maysun is an Arabic name that signifies beauty and freshness. It is a popular name in many Muslim cultures. The name Maysun carries the meaning “Beautiful, Fresh” and is chosen by families in Islamic traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Arabic tradition and is also used in Arabic, Urdu, Persian. Parents who choose Maysun usually hope their child will grow to embody beautiful, fresh and live with faith, good character and purpose.
data.spiritual_meaning: In Islamic tradition, Maysun is associated with the concept of beauty and purity.
data.etymology: Maysun belongs to the Arabic linguistic tradition and is used in Islamic naming. Its recorded meaning is “Beautiful, Fresh.”
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Maysun total 3, giving a life-path number of 3. Number 3 is linked with Jupiter and with the qualities of creativity, expression and optimism.

in_arabic.name: ميسون
in_arabic.meaning: ميسون تعني الورد الأبيض أو الفتاة الحسناء
in_arabic.long_meaning: ميسون هو اسم علم مؤنث من أصل عربي، مشتق من كلمة 'ميس' التي تعني الورد الأبيض أو الفتاة الحسناء. يستخدم هذا الاسم في العديد من الثقافات الإسلامية للإشارة إلى الجمال والأنوثة. وقد وردت مشتقات هذا الاسم في القرآن الكريم، مما يضفي عليه قيمة دينية وروحانية.

in_urdu.name: ميسون
in_urdu.meaning: ميسون یعنی سفید گل یا حسینہ
in_urdu.long_meaning: ميسون ایک علم مؤنث نام ہے جو عربی زبان سے ماخوذ ہے۔ اس کا مطلب ہے سفید گل یا حسینہ۔ یہ نام جنوبی ایشیائی اسلامی ثقافت میں خوبصورتی اور نسائیت کی علامت کے طور پر استعمال ہوتا ہے۔ اس نام کی عربی جڑیں قرآن کریم میں بھی پائی جاتی ہیں، جس سے اسے ایک مقدس اور روحانی اہمیت حاصل ہے۔

in_hindi.name: मैसुन
in_hindi.meaning: मैसुन का अर्थ है सफेद फूल या सुंदर लड़की
in_hindi.long_meaning: मैसुन एक स्त्रीलिंग नाम है जो अरबी भाषा से लिया गया है। इसका अर्थ है सफेद फूल या सुंदर लड़की। यह नाम भारतीय मुस्लिम समुदाय में सौंदर्य और स्त्रीत्व के प्रतीक के रूप में प्रयोग किया जाता है। इस नाम की अरबी जड़ें कुरआन में भी पाई जाती हैं, जिससे इसे एक पवित्र और आध्यात्मिक महत्व मिलता है।

in_pashto.name: میسون
in_pashto.meaning: میسون د سپینو ګلونو یا ښکلۍ نجلۍ معنی لري
in_pashto.long_meaning: میسون یو مونث نوم دی چی د عربی ژبې څخه اخیستل شوی دی. دا د سپینو ګلونو یا ښکلۍ نجلۍ معنی لري. دا نوم د افغان او پښتني کلتور کې د ښکلا او ښځینه توب د نښان په توګه کارول کیږي. د دې نوم عربی ريښې د قرآن کریم کې هم موندل کیږي، چې له دې څخه یې مقدس او روحاني ارزښت ترلاسه کوي.

in_english.name: Maysun
in_english.meaning: Maysun means white rose or beautiful girl
in_english.long_meaning: Maysun is a feminine given name derived from Arabic roots. It means 'white rose' or 'beautiful girl', symbolizing beauty and femininity. The name has Quranic origins and is used across various Muslim cultures. It signifies purity, elegance, and spiritual significance.

data.cultural_impact: The name Maysun is often associated with an individual who embodies radiant beauty, both on the inside and the outside. This name is celebrated in many Muslim communities, particularly during naming ceremonies or occasions where children are being introduced to their extended families. The name can also be seen adorned on various items, such as jewelry or wall art, as a representation of internal and external charm. In addition, it's a commonly used name for female characters in Islamic literature, proving its deep connection to the Islamic culture.
data.spiritual_significance: The name Maysun holds a deeper spiritual significance in the Islamic tradition. It is believed that every human being is a unique creation of the Most Compassionate (Ar-Rahman) and the Most Merciful (Ar-Rahim), given to them as a precious gift. This name represents the inner beauty and freshness that is present in every individual, even if it is hidden beneath the layers of imperfection or hardship. The Prophet Muhammad (peace be upon him) once said, "Verily, every child is born by the fitrah (natural state, purified by Allah). Then, his parents make him a Jew, a Christian, or a Magian." (Bukhari, Muslim) Thus, the name Maysun is a reminder of the inherent beauty and freshness that is present in everyone. It is an invitation to embrace one's inner self and reflect upon one's potential for spiritual growth and purification.
